Bank of Baroda Manager Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the notification for the post of Manager, Senior Manager, Chief Manager, Senior Manager C & IC, Chief Manager – C & IC. This recruitment has been issued for 86 posts. Online applying process for Bank of Baroda Apprentices Recruitment 2026 has started on 16 June 2026 & the candidates can apply till 06 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of Baroda Manager Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 16 June 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 06 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : ₹ 850/-
  • SC, ST, PWD, ESM/DESM & Women : ₹ 175/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
